Michigan born and Philadelphia based artist Digital Guts started producing music in 2021 and then started officially releasing music in 2026. The name comes from the desire to put his soul or "guts" into a digital sound. Digital Guts makes everything himself from the beats to the vocals, taking insperation from Emo-Rap, Hyperpop, and EDM.
